name: hol-guard
description: Local-first AI agent security evidence and approval workflows through HOL Guard's MCP server.
long_description: HOL Guard exposes sanitized local Guard status, security receipts, inventory, policy validation, and approval-backed policy workflows over stdio. The MCP bundle installs the open-source hol-guard Python package locally with uv and does not require Guard Cloud.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search sanitized local Guard receipts and inventory.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one sanitized Guard receipt or inventory item by opaque ID.

tools.name: get_guard_status
tools.description: Report local Guard availability and data freshness.

tools.name: validate_policy
tools.description: Validate candidate HOL Guard policy YAML without writing it.

tools.name: create_policy
tools.description: Request an approval-backed HOL Guard policy write when local policy authoring is enabled.

tools.name: get_policy_creation
tools.description: Inspect a pending or completed policy creation request.
